extraction_notes: Fiscal deficit, revenue deficit, and primary deficit percentages are based on GSDP. Revenue deficit and primary deficit are reported as 0 as the state had a surplus in 2021-22 (Page 10, 33). Outstanding debt is the figure reported in Finance Accounts before audit adjustments for extra-budgetary borrowings (Page 36, Table 1.8). Audit paras raised this year and outstanding over 5 years refer to the total pending cases of misappropriation, losses, thefts, etc. as of 31 March 2022 (Page 127, Table 4.17 & 4.18), as all listed cases in Table 4.18 are older than 5 years. No specific number for PAC recommendations pending was found, so 0 is reported.
